title: 2021 Stainless Steel Tip by DynaVap
description:
DynaVap’s Stainless Steel Tip is used on the “M” vaporizer but can also be used on all vapcaps.
What you can expect out of a stainless tip is a slower heat up time but will also hold heat slightly longer than titanium.
Dynavap describes this tip as ”
The 2021 Stainless Steel Tip – a
Septa serrated fully faceted extraction chamber
that sits atop an
incremental fin profile
. Contained inside the extraction chamber is our two position
Adjust-a-Bowl feature
that allows you to adjust the size of the dosing chamber to your needs”.
Included
1 x 2021 Stainless Steel Tip
